name: Etched Rune
summary: In Coldridge Valley, the Etched Rune invites aspiring dwarven hunters to Anvilmar. Hunter trainer Thorgas Grimson sends it to begin their formal wilderness instruction.

sections.title: Call of the Wild
sections.body: The Etched Rune bears dwarven runes and reaches novices who show promise in Coldridge Valley’s snowdrifts. Mountaineer and hunter trainer Thorgas Grimson sends it to call fledgling trackers to Anvilmar. The rune marks their first step beyond basic survival and into the craft of the wild: respecting Dun Morogh’s beasts, tracking mountain predators, caring for ranged weapons, and enduring the harsh elements.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Etched Rune?
aliases: why do i have etched rune
faq.answer: The Etched Rune calls aspiring dwarven hunters to seek Thorgas Grimson inside Anvilmar for formal guidance in the hunter’s craft.

faq.q: Who wrote or sent the Etched Rune?
faq.answer: Thorgas Grimson, the hunter trainer in Anvilmar, sends the rune to novice outdoorsmen in Coldridge Valley who show a knack for surviving the frozen wilderness.

faq.q: Where do I take the Etched Rune once I have read it?
aliases: where do i bring etched rune
faq.answer: Take the Etched Rune to Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. Thorgas Grimson stands near the forge and training halls, ready to teach you tracking, weapon care, and dwarven hunting traditions.

angles.text: As a hunter, the rune calls you into the craft of dwarven hunting, with its focus on tracking, respecting your animal companions, and surviving the wilderness through your own wits.
As a dwarf, you know carved stones and runes carry trade knowledge and urgent instructions, even through Coldridge Valley’s snows.
